# Solvi

## 1. Description

**Solvi** is the internal management system for your operation. It receives and queries requests generated by **Solvi**, enabling technical triage, budget management, order and service order control, status updates, and support for service execution across the organization.

**Solvi** is not the main client portal. Its focus is on internal operations, providing support to the team and centralizing process organization.

### 1.1 Key features

**Solvi** was designed to be lightweight, intuitive, and efficient. With just a few clicks, you can add tickets, generate reports, manage activities, and administer employees.

The system includes built-in authentication and a local database, removing the need for a constant internet connection. This way, it can run offline, ensuring greater performance, reliability, and consistency throughout the user experience.

## 2. Installation

After downloading the executable file, open the system and contact a **Fix** representative to create your profile. This profile is linked to a database specific to your organization, ensuring access to the correct information.

If you prefer to use the system locally only, you can also create your own user directly in the application. To do this, click the **"Register"** option and fill in the required data to complete the registration.
